narrative: Material PL1__MF6E6E72 is a fast-moving item with mean daily demand of ~10,706 units and a stable coefficient of variation of 0.205. Lead times average 5.84 working days with low variability (CV=0.191), making the system well-suited to a continuous-review (r,Q) policy. The current SAP policy uses a near-MOQ order quantity that generates ~1,294 annual replenishments, with ordering costs dominating total cost; switching to the EOQ-sized order of 41,512 units reduces orders to 65 per year and cuts total annual cost by 86%.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is continuous, fast-moving, and shows no trend or intermittency. Lead times are stable. The (r,Q) model is theoretically optimal under these conditions and minimises total inventory cost while meeting the 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage utilisation is 43.4% (62,991 / 145,187 units). No capacity constraint binds. If annual demand grows by more than ~130%, the storage gate will begin to constrain the EOQ.
